title: Pre-closure Checklist — Always-clickable Close Claim button with status checklist
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — CLM-2024-001 has open tasks + open sections (blockers present)

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: Always clickable, primary style — never disabled or tooltipped because of blockers. With active blockers it opens on step 1 (Blockers); with none, it skips straight to the checklist.

walkthroughSteps: With blockers present, step 1 shows the deep blocker cards (litigation / reserves / provider) — Cancel is the only footer action here

walkthroughSteps.title: Pre-closure Checklist
walkthroughSteps.body: 7 system-validated conditions (sections, payments, bills, recoveries & deductibles, reserves, litigation, reports). Failing rows show a red exclamation icon plus a hint of what's outstanding; passing rows show a green check.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Continue stays disabled until every row passes.

walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-02 — all tasks done, all sections closed, no other blockers — the modal now opens directly on the checklist with all 7 rows green and Continue enabled
Continue → Reason & Retention (pick a reason, retention default/indefinite) → Continue

walkthroughSteps.title: Confirmation
walkthroughSteps.body: One combined, handler-attested list (not system-validated) — pending bills, recoveries & deductibles, final reports, Provider Management survey.

walkthroughSteps.title: No
walkthroughSteps.body: Declining here returns to the Pre-closure Checklist step (step 2) — not back to Reason & Retention.

walkthroughSteps.title: Yes — Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: Confirms closure — status chip updates to Closed and the closure panel appears.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given blockers exist, Close Claim is always clickable; modal opens and shows blocked conditions with Continue disabled.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The **Close Claim** button is always rendered as an enabled primary button (never disabled with a tooltip). When clicked with active blockers, the modal opens at the **Pre-closure Checklist** step — each condition row shows a **Blocked** badge (red) or **Clear** badge (green). The **Continue** button is disabled while any condition is blocked.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 with open tasks and open sections so blockers are present in the checklist.

preconditions.text: 'Close Claim' button is rendered and clickable (primary style, not disabled)
Clicking 'Close Claim' opens modal — title 'Close Claim — Pre-closure Checklist'
'All sections closed' row shows Blocked badge (red icon)
'Continue' button in modal footer is disabled

expectedUI.description: Close Claim button is primary (enabled). Modal checklist shows conditions with blocked rows for tasks and sections. Continue is disabled.
visualCues: Close Claim button: primary style, not greyed out, no tooltip
Blocked rows: red exclamation icon, red 'Blocked' badge, detail text from blocker label
Clear rows: green check icon, green 'Clear' badge

howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens at checklist, blocked rows visible, Continue disabled

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given all conditions are clear, the checklist shows all green and Continue is enabled.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When all closure conditions are met (tasks done, sections closed, no other blockers), all 7 checklist rows show a **Clear** badge (green check icon) and the **Continue** button is enabled. Proceeding leads to Reason → Confirmation → successful claim closure.

setup.description: All tasks done, all sections closed, no litigation/reserves/payments/provider blockers on CLM-2024-001.

preconditions.text: Clicking Continue navigates to Reason step

expectedUI.description: All 7 condition rows show green check icon + 'Clear' badge. Continue is enabled. Flow: checklist → reason & retention → confirmation warning → closed.
visualCues: All rows: green check icon (check-circle-o), green 'Clear' badge
After Continue: modal title changes to 'Close Claim — Reason & Retention'
After selecting reason + Continue: modal title changes to 'Close Claim — Confirmation'
After Close Claim: status chip updates to Closed

howToTest.trigger: Click 'Close Claim', then Continue, select reason, Continue, Yes — Close Claim
howToTest.expectedResult: Claim status changes to Closed, closure panel visible

acceptanceCriteria.statement: After the Reason & Retention step, a single combined confirmation warning gates the final Close Claim action; clicking No returns the handler to the checklist.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Clicking **Continue** on the Reason & Retention step opens **Close Claim — Confirmation** — a single combined list covering 4 handler-attested items: no pending bills, recoveries & deductibles resolved, final reports completed, and Provider Management survey completed/rejected-with-rationale. These are **not** system-validated. Default state is unconfirmed. Clicking **Yes — Close Claim** proceeds to closure processing. Clicking **No** blocks closure and returns the handler to the **Pre-closure Checklist** step (not just Back to Reason).

setup.description: Same all-clear setup as AC-02 — reach the Reason & Retention step, then Continue into the Confirmation step.

preconditions.text: Modal title reads 'Close Claim — Confirmation' after Continue from Reason & Retention
A single plain-text intro lists all 4 confirmation items — not 4 separate pop-ups
Footer shows 'No' and 'Yes — Close Claim' buttons
Clicking 'No' returns to the Pre-closure Checklist step, not the Reason step

expectedUI.description: One combined intro line listing the 4 handler-attested items as a bullet list, followed by No/Yes footer buttons.
visualCues: Single intro line ('Please confirm before closing:'), not four separate dialogs
4 bullet items: bills received/processed, recoveries & deductibles, final reports, Provider Management survey
Clicking 'No' navigates back to the Pre-closure Checklist step (step 2), not the Reason step
Clicking 'Yes — Close Claim' proceeds to closure processing — claim status becomes Closed

howToTest.trigger: Click 'Close Claim' → Continue past checklist → select reason → Continue → observe Confirmation step → click No, then redo and click Yes
howToTest.expectedResult: Clicking No returns to the checklist step; clicking Yes closes the claim
